main_text.head: 2. Contra Mala corporis, seu Morbos, qui referuntur,
main_text.l: partium, Siccorum, Videtur abellam de 12. signis Zodiaci.

page.notes: The page is printed sideways; the diagram is a rotated tree of braces, read here as an outline. Levels are approximate. Words in the upper left, right and lower left margins (faint, partly illegible running and show-through text) are not transcribed. The left-hand side-brace labels near "Curatio-nem" are partly unclear: "sin[gularem?]" is doubtful. The bottom line of the left column of faint text is show-through.
